verdict.label_en: Inflated list price — the list price was charged on only 2 of 33 observed days
verdict.label_ko: 표시정가 부풀림 신호 — 33일 중 2일만 그 가격

price_basis: Olive Young public listing price of the representative option, last observation of each day (KST), observed 1-2 times daily. Excludes coupons and card-issuer discounts. Olive Young sometimes switches the representative option, so a single jump in this series is not by itself proof of a price change.
notice: Themaric presents observed price history only. Whether a discount advertisement violates the law is for the Korea Fair Trade Commission to decide.
disclosure: Olive Young links from Themaric are affiliate links (Olive Young Shopping Curator program): Themaric may earn a commission on purchases. Commissions do not affect verdicts or rankings.
